'''2000 UK National Championship Gary Carman LS''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Gary Carman]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls119.htm Carman HB Tech], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010227193213/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls119.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
